shy.dialogue.chat: Hello, %1$s. I've a little time, and I'd rather spend it on a real conversation than small talk.
shy.dialogue.chat/1: You found me. I don't mind — I like talking, I just don't like talking much.
shy.dialogue.chat/2: Go on, then. I listen better than most, if you've something worth saying.
shy.dialogue.conversations: A proper talk suits me better than a crowd, %1$s. Ask, and I'll answer honestly.
shy.dialogue.conversations/1: I'd like that. One person at a time is how I prefer the world.
shy.dialogue.conversations/2: Quietly, then. I've more to say than I usually let on.
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Good. The week left me alone, mostly, and I got a great deal of thinking done. That's a good week, by my measure.
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/: Well enough. Quiet mornings, work I could do without talking. It suited me.
Better than good. Nobody needed much of me, so there was plenty left over for myself.
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: It's been a heavy week, and a loud one. I didn't expect anyone to ask, %1$s. I'm glad you did.
Not good. Too many people, too little quiet. I'm running low on myself.
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You asked already, %1$s. The answer hasn't changed — I don't change that quickly.
Twice. I'm the same as I was an hour ago. I usually am.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.good: A good day. I walked the long way round, where nobody goes, and came back with my thoughts in order.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Quiet and useful. The garden asked nothing of me but hands. Those are my favourite days.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The square was full and stayed full. I've been rebuilding myself behind the fence ever since.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Too much noise, too many people wanting words. I'm worn thin, %1$s. It'll pass by morning.
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.like: I do. It's honest work that doesn't require an audience — just me, the task, and enough quiet to think.
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: Very much. My hands work and my mind wanders somewhere better. That's a fair arrangement.
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: The work's fine. It's the constant company that wears at me — I'd do twice as much with half the conversation.
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: It's not the labour I mind, %1$s. It's that it happens in front of everyone.
shy.dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s suits me. I know which paths stay empty and which hours the square is quiet. That's what makes a place home.
shy.dialogue.conversations.village.home/: I like %2$s at dawn, before it fills. For an hour it belongs entirely to me and the birds.
shy.dialogue.conversations.people.first: They're decent, and I'm fond of them — in small numbers, and briefly. That's not a complaint, it's just how I'm built.
shy.dialogue.conversations.people.first/: Good people. I'd rather know three of them properly than all of them a little.
shy.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Bread and butter by a window, eaten slowly, with no one waiting on me to say something.
shy.dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Whatever the inn serves when the inn is empty. The soup tastes better without the crowd.
shy.dialogue.conversations.life.first: It's a small, quiet story, %1$s, and I've never minded that. Sit down — I'll tell it properly, since you asked.
shy.dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: Not much happens in it, and what does happens inwardly. I prefer it that way.
shy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A garden behind a tall hedge, and long afternoons nobody interrupts. Modest, I know. I've thought about it a great deal.
shy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/: A room with a door I can close, and a whole day on the other side of it. That's the entire dream.
shy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That the quiet becomes permanent — that I'd get so good at being alone I'd forget how to stop.
shy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Being alone by habit rather than by choice. There's a difference, and it's easy to lose.
shy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.firs: You're the one person I don't have to prepare for, %1$s. Given how I'm made, that's a considerable thing to say.
I don't need to gather myself before you arrive. I've never managed that with anyone else.
shy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.perso: That's further in than I go with most people, %1$s. Not never — just not yet. Keep coming by.
I keep that one to myself for now. Ask again when we've known each other longer.
shy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.intim: That's the deepest room in the house, %1$s, and I don't open it often. Be patient with me and I might.
You're asking for something I've shown almost no one. Someday. Not today.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: I hear very little, %1$s. Conversations tend to stop when I come near — not unkindly, they just do.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Nothing to report. I'm rarely where news is made, and that's mostly on purpose.
shy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Yes. Quietly, and completely. I'd not have let anyone this close otherwise, %1$s.
shy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/: I am. You're the only company that doesn't cost me anything to keep.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marria: %2$s and %3$s were married. I watched from the edge of the square — it was a good day, and I'm glad I saw it.
Word is %2$s and %3$s wed. I didn't stay for the dancing, but they looked genuinely happy.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorc: %2$s and %3$s have separated. I won't add to the talk about it — there's already too much of that.
%2$s and %3$s parted. The square has been noisy with opinions. I've kept mine to myself.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: %2$s has died, %1$s. I keep looking toward their door out of habit. I don't have better words than that.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/: We lost %2$s. I'd rather sit with it quietly than talk about it, if that's all right.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s was born this week. I looked in once, briefly. Very small, very new. It was worth the crowd.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/: There's a new one — %2$s. I didn't stay long, but I'm glad they're here.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arriva: %2$s has moved in. I've not introduced myself yet. I will, once the novelty has worn off for everyone else.
Someone new: %2$s. I'll get to know them slowly. That's the only way I know how.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depart: %2$s left for good. We spoke rarely, but I noticed them — I notice most people. The village is quieter now.
%2$s has moved on. I never did have a proper conversation with them. I regret that a little.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.confused: I didn't follow that. Say it again, slower?
shy.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: That one lost me. Try once more.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.hint: You could ask about %2$s. I'd answer that properly.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: I don't know. I'd rather say so than guess.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s, or %3$s? One at a time is easier.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: I've lost where we were. Start again?
shy.dialogue.chatmode.busy: In the middle of something. A moment.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.muted: All right. I'm good at quiet.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Silence, then. That suits me fine.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Goodbye, %1$s. That was a good talk.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.insult: That was unnecessary. I'll leave it there.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Oh, hello. I was hoping it'd be someone I like.
